candidates.title: Sheltered village rain
candidates.edit_plan: Choose a steady segment, soften direct high-frequency rain and add gentle loop crossfade; represent shelter through the edit, without new recorded room facts.
candidates.qualification: Measure seam/mono compatibility and keep room-tone/interior impression subordinate to rain.

candidates.title: Running water and rain
candidates.edit_plan: Layer a stream excerpt with the same rain source at a lower combined level; do not add wildlife or stack a second full-volume region bed.
candidates.qualification: Retain intelligible water texture; document both source trim windows and combined gain.

candidates.title: Rain under leaves
candidates.edit_plan: Trim and fade the leaf-rain excerpt; test its advertised loop and soften hiss only if the material remains identifiable.
candidates.qualification: Keep CC BY 4.0 credit and edit notice with every derivative; no insects, birds or clue beacon.

candidates.title: Exposed wind/rain with inert creak
candidates.edit_plan: Use a mild wind window and rain; place one soft isolated wooden creak with no periodic motion rhythm.
candidates.qualification: Reject bag rustle or modern noise; creak is a material analogue, never hidden character evidence.

candidates.title: Packed earth
candidates.edit_plan: Select three to six softer dirt contacts, trim individual tails and sequence at a calm pace with real gaps.
candidates.qualification: Confirm soil timbre rather than gritty gravel; later terrain ownership remains unassigned.

candidates.title: Gravel
candidates.edit_plan: Select three to six distinct contacts and retain granule detail with controlled peaks.
candidates.qualification: No running rhythm, clothing or environment bed masquerading as each step.

candidates.title: Leaf litter
candidates.edit_plan: Select three to six leaf contacts and modest rustle tails; avoid artificially equal peak normalization.
candidates.qualification: Audition against B03 so each contact remains distinct from canopy rain.

candidates.title: Timber
candidates.edit_plan: Extract three to six walking contacts; attenuate boomy resonances and fade trim edges.
candidates.qualification: Record MP3 ancestry; do not map hollow timber to a physical surface from visual appearance.

candidates.title: Water contact
candidates.edit_plan: Select two or three small splashes and preserve short recovery gaps.
candidates.qualification: No sea waves, slime creature sound or unauthorized water action.

candidates.title: Container and cloth
candidates.edit_plan: Combine one soft wooden container contact with light cotton handling; keep components identifiable.
candidates.qualification: No claim of ceramic source; container material and actual actions remain future authored choices.

candidates.title: Hand tool
candidates.edit_plan: Select a light manual-tool contact/scrape, with brief pauses between two demonstrations.
candidates.qualification: Reject cinematic impacts, gun/weapon sounds, powered tools or unrelated doors.

candidates.title: Mortar and preparation
candidates.edit_plan: Trim a quiet stone grinding passage and two soft taps; preserve source dynamics.
candidates.qualification: No unlicensed ingredient inference, generated grinding sound or asserted remedy result.

candidates.title: Restrained treatment result
candidates.edit_plan: Derive a gentle cloth-settle and soft wooden contact distinct from the handling excerpt; accompany a text slate identifying a hypothetical delivered result.
candidates.qualification: Confirmation remains presentation only; no magic chime, disease claim or wall-clock disease advance.

candidates.title: UI and conversation feedback
candidates.edit_plan: Select separate quiet interface and conversation start/end clicks; demonstrate in labelled non-overlapping subsegments.
candidates.qualification: Each subsegment routes once; no spoken voice, per-letter sound or mandatory sound-only information.

candidates.title: Sparse exploration texture
candidates.edit_plan: Choose a sparse guitar-led passage and fade with long silence around it; no new composition or stem-separation model.
candidates.qualification: Optional audition example; reject vocals, urgency or implied hidden truth.

candidates.title: Rest and healing motif
candidates.edit_plan: Trim a short acoustic motif with a gentle end and long cooldown gap; do not assign any runtime trigger.
candidates.qualification: Must support calm rest without claiming treatment success or disease-pause semantics.

budget.cap_behavior: Pause if exceeded; no paid substitution or account creation. Catalogue MB figures are rounded, not exact bytes. Labour/network costs are excluded.

future_acquisition_sequence: After explicit authority, use only these named source containers; retain page/licence notices and originals with SHA-256 before any edit. Download original files, never compressed preview streams.

Freesound originals require owner-mediated login/download; an existing authenticated session or owner-supplied originals may be used. If unavailable, report access need without requesting pasted credentials, creating an account, bypassing login or silently using a mirror.

Inspect each archive without executing its contents; select members by the named material class, capture exact filename and hash, preserve licence/supplied notices and reject any conflicting rights record.

Qualify catalogue descriptions by listening after authority; isolate nonvocal material without added wildlife, modern vehicles, incidental people or broadcast music. If a class cannot qualify, retain a named gap and stop before presenting an incomplete series as complete.
Prepare the complete sixteen excerpts first, with immutable originals and explicit edit lineage. Keep these external to game runtime assets; do not ask the owner to select each excerpt separately.

Render the same scripted five-minute timeline in Default, Reduced range and music-free variants; keep an isolated audition workspace, the existing approved bus layout and available local ffmpeg/ffprobe. Any derived tooling belongs only to the external audition package or disposable workspace.

Measure final rendered output and loop/contact behaviour; deliver all sixteen excerpts, three mixes, provenance/credits, measurements and one collective listening review. Record selection only from actual owner acceptance.

working_format_proposed.editing_precision: float where supported; verify source 32-bit subtype rather than assuming
working_format_proposed.review_exports: PCM WAV, 48 kHz, 24-bit; stereo beds/music and labelled mono-compatible effects
working_format_proposed.source_codec_policy: Preserve original FLAC/WAV/MP3 and unknown archive encodings; PCM conversion of lossy sources is not a recovered lossless recording. Runtime encoding remains deferred.

measurements_after_acquisition: Actual metadata and decoded corruption/clipping checks for each original
Each excerpt sample/true peaks, RMS and trim/fade boundaries; no LUFS-I target for individual short transients
Beds loop seam waveform and audible seam, repeat stability and mono fold-down; music edit endings
Five-minute Default, Reduced range and music-free final output LUFS-I/LRA and sample/true peaks with stated measurement point
Working mix peaks before final protection, concurrency gains and comparison to unchanged provisional policy targets
Labelled bus routing: required Effects unchanged by optional ducking, category/Master zero and mute, mono and range comparisons in isolated audition
Listening notes for stereo/mono, headphones/speakers, low volume, muted and reduced range; unavailable devices explicitly unassessed
voice_reference: None. No speech, microphone, TTS, human recording or generated voices; speech masking/intelligibility and future voice targets stay unassessed.
remaining_scope: Footsteps/actions/ambience/music are still absent from ordinary runtime. Inscription uses a quieter edit of B03 only after existing authored state; no fifth candidate or pre-discovery clue cue.

next_authority_decision.requested_action: Authorize the zero-purchase-cost acquisition, editing, qualification listening and isolated collective audition of this exact shortlist: sixteen excerpts and three five-minute mixes, with provenance/credits and measurements, capped at 500 MB source downloads and 2 GB working storage. Freesound originals use an existing authenticated owner session or owner-supplied files.
exclusions: AI generation, new recording, speech/providers or microphone
Ordinary runtime audio assets/emitters, Main/world/perception/time changes, accepted visuals or gait
